title: The snow-globe orchestra
alt: A glass snow globe contains an intricate miniature concert hall with a grand piano and red velvet seats.
description: A collector-object scene combines miniature architecture, curved glass and fine drifting snow.
prompt: A remarkable complete glass snow globe on a dark walnut base containing a miniature empty concert hall. Tiny red velvet seats face a raised wooden stage with one grand piano, gold acoustic panels line the walls and a delicate central chandelier hangs from an arched interior roof. All hall elements fit within the globe; fine white snow particles drift around the miniature architecture without hiding it. Intricate material detail, realistic curved glass refraction, sophisticated collector-object photograph, no text.
